title: Dating an Air Sign.
old_caption: First date with an air sign? Pick somewhere to think, skip the small talk and ask the strange question. Then really listen. Curiosity is the way in.

title: Dating an Earth Sign.
old_caption:
Planning a date with an Earth sign? Think cozy dinner or a market stroll, ask about their plans and comfort food, and arrive on time.
Steady effort is how they feel cared for.

title: Dating a Fire Sign.
old_caption:
Taking a Fire sign out? Pick somewhere with energy, ask about their biggest dreams, and maybe skip the slow silent movie.
Match their spark with enthusiasm, and you'll both have fun.

title: Dating a Water Sign.
old_caption: First date with a water sign? Choose somewhere quiet, ask how they're feeling and let the answer run long. Skip the rush. With water signs, slow and gentle is the way in.

title: After the Breakup.
old_caption:
Day one is a blanket burrito. Day twelve brings a setback. Day twenty brings the first real laugh.
Healing after a breakup isn't a straight line, and good friends stay with you through every step.

title: The Hype Friend.
old_caption:
Pre-date nerves meet one best friend with pom-poms, a pep talk and snacks for any outcome.
The friend who hypes you up and waits for the debrief is a love story too. Send this to yours.

title: Your Own Biggest Fan.
old_caption: That inner voice that critiques your outfit and your texts? It's usually trying to protect you. Talk back to it kindly, the way you'd talk to a good friend.

title: EaDo.
old_caption: EaDo's star paints three murals before lunch and hides the sketchbook under its beret. Even camouflage didn't work, Libra saw the eyes. What do you hide from your date?

title: Midtown.
old_caption: Midtown's star: brunch at 11, rooftop at 4, table for forty. Then one person sits down to share something real and the phone keeps buzzing. Tag your friend who is always out.

title: Third Ward.
old_caption: Date three, and Capricorn meets the porch committee: auntie wants to know if you ate, unc wants to know who your people are, and the baby pictures come out. Who's on your porch committee?
